# Millstone
Two stones on a treated-wood frame, turned by hand or by redstone. No power.
- Use it holding something to mill to put the stack in (hoppers and conduits can feed it from the sides and top).
- Use it with an empty hand to turn the stone once. Each item takes a few turns.
- A redstone pulse turns it too, so a clock or an observer can run it.
- Sneak-use with an empty hand to take what it made; hoppers and conduits take it from underneath.

| In | Out | Turns |
| Wheat | Flour (25%: another) | 2 |
| Any seeds | Seed Meal | 1 |
| Bone | 4 Bone Meal (50%: a fifth) | 3 |
| Sugar Cane | 2 Sugar | 1 |
Flour smelts or smokes into Bread. Seed Meal is a light fertilizer for Loam Farmland (+1 nutrient), and the Fertilizer Spreader takes it.
# Mill
The powered Millstone: three lanes, each milling an item in half the recipe's time (5 s for wheat), with 8 FE/t per working lane. Items put in through an input face go to the emptiest lane. Speed and Energy upgrades work.
